policies.name: Academic Integrity
description: Absolute integrity is expected of every Carthage student in all academic undertakings, at all Ɵmes. The importance of following this guideline cannot be overstated. For the purposes of this class, it is especially disallowed to use AI to write your code. If you are using a particular post from stackoverflow, please cite it in a comment line in your code. Failure to comply with expectaƟons regarding academic integrity will result in serious penalƟes that will have repercussions for the rest of your academic career. For more information on academic integrity, please refer to Carthage College's Community Code.

policies.name: AI Usage
description: However, in an educational environment you should get used to using AI as a tutor rather than an assistant. Use it to help you do the work, don't offload the work to it. Learn from the explanations provided, then apply that understanding to your work. Repeat this process as needed. AI assistants have infinite patience for your questions.

When you graduate, you will be competing with people who learned to code before AI assistants existed. These people may use AI for their daily work today, but they benefit from having built their foundational knowledge without relying on it during their formative years. This likely makes them better equipped and more resilient to handle the inherent uncertainty in building software systems

When you enter the tech-related workforce, employers will expect you to solve coding problems independently without the use of AI tools. For sure, this will include during job interviews but it also includes brainstorming with teammates. You must be able to think creativelyand communicate about your code without relying on AI. Even if you excel at programming with AI assistance, being unable to demonstrate your skills without it will significantly hinder your job prospects.

policies.name: Be a Good Human
description: No human likes to be treated poorly, so no human should endeavor to treat other humans poorly. As such, bigotry, bullying, or any other form of mistreatment of others will not be tolerated in this class.

cscGEN.course_catalog_description: Explore the fundamental AI algorithms used in simulations and game development. This course covers techniques like pathfinding, decision trees, behavior trees, finite state machines, and machine learning. Students will apply these algorithms to create more dynamic, responsive, and intelligent virtual environments. Ideal for those interested in game design, simulations, and AI programming.

course_learning_goals.detail: AI algorithms such as pathfinding, decision trees, and behavior trees to create dynamic and responsive simulations.
the performance and effectiveness of different AI techniques in game and simulation environments.
intelligent behaviors for virtual environments by implementing AI-driven systems and solutions.
the use of machine learning algorithms in simulations, determining their suitability for specific scenarios.
a fully functional AI-driven simulation project that demonstrates the integration of multiple AI techniques.
